findings: Sokolow Lyon voltage of 35 mm or more

echoTasks.find: Concentric wall thickening with a normal sized cavity in long axis
Markedly thickened septal and posterior walls with a small cavity in short axis
Enlarged left atrium with diastolic dysfunction in the apical window

auscultation.added: Fourth sound from the stiff ventricle

exam.general: Middle aged man, obese, no distress at rest
exam.other: Fundus shows arteriovenous nicking, urine shows trace protein, no oedema
exam.pulse: Regular 70, good volume, all pulses felt

history.a: Hypertensive for 12 years, takes amlodipine irregularly, pressures 160 to 170 systolic at home
Morning headaches, no chest pain, mild exertional breathlessness
Diabetic for 4 years on metformin, smokes beedis
No prior echo, no known kidney disease
Father died of stroke at 60, mother hypertensive

keyPoints: Tighten blood pressure control to target with adherence counselling and home monitoring, per the hypertension guideline
Add statin and glycaemic control for global vascular risk reduction
Counsel on salt reduction, weight loss and daily walking with a written plan
Schedule yearly echo with identical linear measurements to track regression
Screen for sleep apnoea and renal dysfunction as drivers of resistant pressure
management.model: Intensive pressure and risk factor control with protocolised yearly mass tracking

required.answer: severe mass index, 160 g per sq m

sources: ASE chamber quantification guideline, in own words
Hypertension management guideline on target organ assessment, in own words
stem: A 59 year old shopkeeper from Meerut with 12 years of poorly controlled hypertension presents for cardiac assessment with morning headaches. Blood pressure remains above target despite prescribed amlodipine.
teaching: Severe means mass index above 149 in men and above 122 in women
Concentric thickening with a normal cavity plus a fourth sound is pressure overload physiology
The sonographer measures septum, posterior wall and cavity at the same level every time
Identical linear technique yearly is what makes regression visible
title: Severe hypertensive left ventricular hypertrophy
